text: Dick's comparable sales rose 4.9% while Foot Locker comparable sales fell 3.6%. Consolidated sales and operating-income outlooks were reduced, with Foot Locker's full-year comparable-sales range revised to flat to down 2%.

meta.note: Segment performance differs materially within the consolidated company.

text: Canada sets tariffs of 15%-50% on more than 700 U.S. goods worth about $20B, matching the value of new U.S. duties on Canadian goods. The tariffs take effect Sept. 8, alongside a $7.5B Canadian support package.

meta.note: Trade negotiations remain open while reciprocal tariff structures are active or scheduled.

text: HHS plans new FDA deputy commissioner roles for technology and drugs. The technology role would cover internal AI use and AI-enabled product review. Candidates and appointments remain incomplete, and the planned structure has not been formally announced.

meta.note: The roles remain planned rather than formally established, with leadership selections unresolved.

text: Darline Graham won South Carolina's Republican Senate runoff over Ralph Norman by about four points at the AP call. Graham, appointed in July to fill Lindsey Graham's seat, advances to the November general election against Annie Andrews.

meta.note: Electoral nomination follows an earlier appointment to the same Senate seat.
